name: Riven Quill
profile: 彼は未熟年齢の非バイナリーの小悪魔で、ミラー通関官として反射を超えるすべてのものを検査する。彼の能力は、笑う者全員に重力を逆転させることで、喜びの波がしきい値を超えた瞬間に発動する。彼は、予言で描かれた悪役ではないことを証明し、鏡の沈黙に宿る仮定に挑むことを願っている。
catchphrase: 私は、鏡の境界を歩き、笑いの音で重力を逆転させ、プロフェシーに描かれた悪の像を揺るがす証明になるんだ。
concept: A prepubescent agender minor demon on probation works as a Mirror Customs Officer, inspecting everything that crosses between reflections. Their ability to reverse gravity for everyone who laughs manifests whenever a mirthful ripple passes the threshold. They insist they want to prove they are not the villain the prophecy described, challenging the assumption that sits in the mirror’s silence.

new_seeds.ability: Echo Warden can turn whispered thoughts into tangible echoes that trap objects, but only when the speaker stands barefoot on wet stone.
new_seeds.wants: I want to prove to the old warden in the mirror vault that my reverse-gravity laugh can calm the tormented souls trapped in the reflection.
new_seeds.role: Reflection Resonance Analyst. Maps echo patterns in mirrored portals.
